description: Parameter set of not a vehicle: Marie's body scaled geometrically by 1.6, every value derived by similitude, so the same test file runs on a second torpedo geometry with only the data swapped. Values are grouped by the component that declares them; every entry names its kind and source; see SOURCE.md.

length.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power 1, of Marie's value (published: NTNU AUR-Lab, LAUV Marie page (https://www.ntnu.edu/web/aur-lab/lauv-marie), read 2026-10-10, technical specifications: length 215 cm)

diameter.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power 1, of Marie's value (published_second_hand: OceanScan LAUV-family hull diameter as printed in the MSS-Capytaine example README)

body_mass.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power 3, of Marie's value (published: NTNU AUR-Lab, LAUV Marie page (https://www.ntnu.edu/web/aur-lab/lauv-marie), read 2026-10-10, technical specifications: weight in air 34 kg)

body_center_of_gravity.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6, of Marie's value (estimate: MSS-Capytaine example README: centre of gravity 0.01 m below the centre of buoyancy (read from the file as main.CG))

rigid_body_form.source: inertia of a uniform cylinder (the file's radii of gyration), the same body the added mass was computed for

inertia_diagonal.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6, of Marie's value (derived: file MRB (about the centre of gravity) moved to the origin by H(r)^T MRB H(r), Fossen 2011 eq. 3.24 p. 49; an estimate (a uniform cylinder's radii of gyration))

inertia_products.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6, of Marie's value (derived: as inertia_diagonal)

body_density.source: mean density of the idealised hull, mass / full volume; unread with rigid_body_form 'given_inertia'

added_mass_form.source: boundary-element added mass of the idealised hull

added_mass_matrix.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6, of Marie's value (bem: LAUV_marie.mat A(infinity) (frequency entry 36, the 10 rad/s sentinel; zero speed, 5 m submergence), shifted from the centre of gravity to the body origin by H(r)^T A H(r), r = main.CG, Fossen 2011 eq. 3.24 p. 49)

integration_max_step.source: numerical step of the vehicle's own integrator

buoyancy_method.source: partly submerged hull form, integrated over the hull profile: exact at the surface and fully submerged (a regime is a state, not a separate part)

center_of_buoyancy.source: the body origin is the centre of buoyancy of the idealised hull (the file's CB differs by 2 micrometres)

displaced_volume.source: pi R^2 (Lc + 2 (Lf + La)/3) of the idealised hull profile; read by 'from_volume' only (the floating method integrates the profile)
displaced_volume.route_to_measured: the hull lines; a weighing in water (reserve buoyancy)

buoyancy.source: rho g V of the full hull; read by 'given' only

cylinder_length.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power 1, of Marie's value (estimate: MSS-Capytaine example README: generic body, 1.45 m cylindrical midbody)

forward_cap_length.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power 1, of Marie's value (estimate: MSS-Capytaine example README: 0.35 m ellipsoidal taper)

aft_cap_length.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power 1, of Marie's value (estimate: MSS-Capytaine example README: 0.35 m ellipsoidal taper)

time_constants.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power 0.5, of Marie's value (placeholder: MSS-Capytaine example: stored inputs of a damping recipe (surge 50 s, sway 5 s, yaw 5 s), read from the file as powerBased.T_1236; not a measurement)

damping_ratios.source: MSS-Capytaine example: stored inputs (roll 0.2, pitch 0.2), read from the file as powerBased.delta_zeta_45; not a measurement
damping_ratios.route_to_measured: roll and pitch decay from the vehicle's logs

oswald_efficiency.route_to_measured: body-lift slope from logged turns and depth changes

planform_fraction.source: MSS rule S = 70 % of the rectangle length x diameter (remus100.m 133), applied to this hull's own length and diameter
planform_fraction.route_to_measured: body-lift slope from logged turns and depth changes

planform_area.source: f L D; unread with planform_area_method 'computed'

hull_frontal_drag_coefficient.source: de Moraes et al. (2025), p. 9: 0.63 on the bare-hull frontal area (0.38 on 0.03 m^2 with all appendages), a different, 1.8 m, fully appendaged vehicle of the same family, 3 hull diameters deep
hull_frontal_drag_coefficient.route_to_measured: steady speed-versus-thrust pairs with a measured thrust law

chord_axis.source: unit chord direction along the hull axis

fin_area.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power 2, of Marie's value (published: Silva et al. (2007), p. 4: fin face area S_fin = 64 cm^2 of the 2007 prototype (1.08 m, 18 kg), not Marie's fins)

lift_slope.source: Silva et al. (2007), p. 4: C_LF = 3, read as the per-fin slope of 1/2 rho A C u^2 delta for the pair formula F = rho C_LF S u^2 delta (two fins: rho C_LF S = 2 * 1/2 rho C S); the 2007 prototype's, not Marie's
lift_slope.route_to_measured: turn and pitch rate versus fin angle from the vehicle's logs

zero_lift_drag.source: no value for this fin; read only by the linear section form

servo_dynamics.source: servo with a lag, a rate limit and an angle limit

servo_rate_limit.source: servo with a lag, a rate limit and an angle limit

servo_angle_limit.source: servo with a lag, a rate limit and an angle limit

time_constant.source: no measured servo time constant exists for the vehicle; 0.1 s is a published value for an AUV fin servo (Sarhadi 2026, arXiv:2601.01302v2, Fig. 4, p. 4)
time_constant.route_to_measured: logged step: commanded versus measured fin position

max_deflection.route_to_measured: maximum measured fin position in the logs

max_rate.source: Config.ini line 77: Maximum Rotation Rate = 300.0 (degrees per second)
max_rate.route_to_measured: fin position rate in the logs

inflow.source: velocity at the fin's own point of the rigid body

interference.source: no body interference on the fin

section.source: lift slope with drag proportional to the squared angle

fins.label: vertical fin, z = +0.128 m (below the axis, FRD)

fin_position.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6, of Marie's value (deployed_configuration: Config.ini line 1785 (fin 0))

lift_axis.source: unit direction of positive lift in body axes (forward-right-down); the simulator's fin force directions, Config.ini lines 1781-1784

fin_position.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6, of Marie's value (deployed_configuration: Config.ini line 1786 (fin 1))

lift_axis.source: unit direction of positive lift in body axes (forward-right-down); the simulator's fin force directions, Config.ini lines 1781-1784

fin_position.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6, of Marie's value (deployed_configuration: Config.ini line 1787 (fin 2))

lift_axis.source: unit direction of positive lift in body axes (forward-right-down); the simulator's fin force directions, Config.ini lines 1781-1784

fins.label: vertical fin, z = -0.128 m (above the axis, FRD)

fin_position.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6, of Marie's value (deployed_configuration: Config.ini line 1788 (fin 3))

lift_axis.source: unit direction of positive lift in body axes (forward-right-down); the simulator's fin force directions, Config.ini lines 1781-1784

drive.source: shaft speed in revolutions per minute

inflow.source: the lumped law reads no advance speed

law.source: thrust = k w |w|, w = 2 pi n: a lumped law, because no propeller geometry of the vehicle exists in any document

min_command.source: no document says whether the vehicle runs its motor astern; none modelled

max_command.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power -0.5, of Marie's value (deployed_configuration: Config.ini line 235: Maximum Motor RPMs = 2340)

position.source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power 1, of Marie's value (deployed_configuration: Config.ini line 1779 (simulator engine position); origin as for the fins)

positive_thrust_coefficient.source: one fit: thrust equal to the modelled hull drag at 1.771 m/s and 917 rpm, the speed table's 50 % row (a configured table, not a measurement), written for w in rad/s
positive_thrust_coefficient.route_to_measured: thrust against shaft speed from a bollard pull and the logs

negative_thrust_coefficient.source: equal to the forward coefficient; unread with min_command 0

shaft_torque_scale.source: no value for the share of shaft torque that rolls the vehicle; not modelled
shaft_torque_scale.route_to_measured: steady roll offset against shaft speed in straight runs

site_form.source: gravity and density as in the hydrodynamic file

kinematic_viscosity.route_to_measured: water temperature from the vehicle's CTD

lamb_spheroid.source: the equivalent spheroid of the same length and diameter (Lamb's added mass), printed for Marie's hull by an independent computation (2026-10-06), and its ratio to the boundary-element diagonal (2026-10-09); at another scale, by similitude (s^3, s^5; the ratios do not change)

speed_table.published_max_speed_source: geometric similitude, scale 1.6 to the power 0.5, of Marie's value (published: NTNU AUR-Lab, LAUV Marie page (https://www.ntnu.edu/web/aur-lab/lauv-marie), read 2026-10-10, technical specifications: speed 0.5-2.5 m/s (the upper bound))
